text:
riya.sales: FYI — ACME Tech demands zero-egress for their POC. They asked if we can do a sneakernet (USB) delivery and on-prem install for the POC. Need: packaging approach, upgrade cadence (how we push patches), signing/checksums, SBOM, and rough SOW/pricing for manual installs. Any immediate blockers?

devin.solutions: quick Q — how big are the model bundles roughly? and do they allow a jumpbox inside the sealed network or literally no network at all?

riya.sales: they said literal no egress; jumpbox only if customer provides an outbound-controlled appliance (very unlikely for POC). Model size ~12GB for quantized variant, plus runtime & deps ~4GB.

marcus.security: security notes up front: chain-of-custody is the main risk. We'll need: signed images/bundles, SBOM for each artifact, GPG (or sigstore) signatures, offline key import procedure (KMS/HSM), and an offline cert rotation plan. Also require an attestation procedure so customer can verify integrity before install.

tariq.engops: feasible. Two packaging options: minibundle (single tar + container runtime) ~16GB or chunked bundles (split artifacts + delta patches). For sneakernet POC I recommend minibundle to reduce manual steps. We can provide:
```
# verify signature example
gpg --verify bundle.tar.gz.sig bundle.tar.gz
sha256sum -c bundle.sha256
```
We'll produce: signed tar, matching SBOM, install script (usb-bootstrap.sh) that runs offline install and writes an audit file. For delta/patches: we can produce signed delta bundles, but applying them is manual unless a jumpbox is available.

anne_pm: pricing/policy: for POC we usually offer a discounted SOW: one-time manual install (+remote support for very limited time) or optional paid onsite/remote engineer. Typical SOW line items: packaging & signing prep, security review & SBOM handoff, test bundle generation, and 1 day install support. Ballpark: $6k — $12k depending on travel/onsite. We can waive travel for an enterprise commitment.

marcus.security: add to sec: we should require checksum + GPG sigs with key fingerprint out-of-band, and require reproducible SBOM. Also request that customer provide a tamper-evident seal process for the USB media.

tariq.engops: upgrade cadence constraints: if customer accepts periodic manual delta installs, we can ship monthly security patches and monthly model deltas. For automated, need a jumpbox + scheduled windows (we support canary + rollback). Manual patch apply: ~30–90 min per host depending on components; plan for maintenance window. Signed deltas reduce risk but still manual.

riya.sales: ok — can we get a packaged checklist + sample minibundle by EOD tomorrow? I'll need it for the SOW draft and to sync with procurement. Also need clear acceptance criteria for them to sign off the POC.

devin.solutions: I can draft the checklist. Action items: @tariq.engops produce sample mini-bundle + usb-bootstrap script, @marcus.security draft minimal security reqs and offline key import flow, @anne_pm draft SOW pricing and acceptance criteria.

ops-bot: Ticket created: #SNEAKERNET-1023 — sneakernet POC prep (assignee: devin.solutions).

riya.sales: perfect — scheduling 30m call tomorrow 10am PT to walk through. Thanks all :thumbsup:
